info.title: outwit-controller-pack — package a built controller for WitCloud admin upload.
info.description: CLI for third-party controller authors. Reads a controller.module/ directory + manifest, validates the schema and asset declarations, and produces a self-contained zip ready for upload to a WitCloud server via the admin UI. Path B (contributor) counterpart to outwit-resolve.

options.name: --output
options.description:
Output zip path. Default: <Name>-<Version>.zip
in the current working directory.

options.name: --allow-external-uris
options.description: Permit dataAssets entries with non-file:// URIs.
